svg.desc: Signal flow through brain's Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B implementation: text/audio/image/video-frames in, through the audio and vision towers, multimodal splice with M-RoPE, the Thinker MoE decoder, the Talker MoE decoder, the MTP code predictor and the Code2Wav vocoder, to generated text and a 24 kHz waveform. Solid = implemented and parity-validated; dashed = documented gap.
svg.text: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B — signal flow through brain’s implementation
brain’s from-scratch Rust + WGSL re-implementation of Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct (35.25 B params total, ~3 B active per token, fp32 engine)
text / audio / image / video-frames in → generated text and 24 kHz synthesized speech out — every box is a real module, every number from the shipped config or a measured run

g.text: padded to whole 1 s chunks (chunk_len 100 × hop 160)
becomes the text rows of the spliced sequence
DeepStack taps [8, 16, 24] — encoded, but skipped by the
served mm::encode_image path (same cut in NPU export, M15)
omni::mm — build_multimodal_prompt · splice_host · encode_audio :82 · encode_image :183 · encode_video_frames :221 • positions: qwenvl::mrope::get_rope_index_multi
text-token + audio + vision embeddings assembled into ONE [T, 2048] sequence — media embeds overwrite their placeholder-token rows (wrapped in the real start / end tokens)
3-axis interleaved M-RoPE over temporal / height / width · mrope_section [24, 20, 20] · theta 1e6 — collapses exactly to plain half-split RoPE for pure-text / pure-audio spans
genuinely 3-axis only for mixed image / video / audio spans (one rope2d_fwd table path serves all cases)
documented approximation: the audio T-axis advances by frame ordinal, not HF’s wall-clock position_id_per_seconds scaling (M9b)
omni::thinker — layer_fwd · layer_decode_step · decode · final_norm · lm_head_fwd
sparse MoE core: model::moe — router_fwd · expert_fwd / expert_fwd_compact / expert_fwd_i8
48 layers · hidden 2048 · GQA 32 query / 4 KV heads · use_qk_norm
MoE: 128 experts, top-8 routed, NO shared expert · moe_inter 768 · softmax top-k router
vocab 152 064 · untied lm_head · 29.91 B resident params · 2.73 B active / token (omni_bench cost, M16)
int8 dual-GPU resident: ThinkerInt8Store / Int8ThinkerResident — layer-range shard across 2 × P40 (M20/M21)
validated: layer cosine 1.000000 (M6a/M6b) · e2e greedy: exact 12-token prefix, then an fp32-vs-bf16 near-tied logit diverged (M9b)
returned by both actions: generate · speak

svg.text: hidden states @ layer 24 (accept_hidden_layer) + generated text tokens

g.text: consumes the Thinker’s HIDDEN STATE at accept_hidden_layer = 24 (not just token embeddings) + text_projection
per-speaker codec embedding: chelsie 2301 · ethan 2302 · aiden 2303 • tts bos / eos / pad = 151 672 / 151 673 / 151 671
speak accepts TEXT user turns only — the multimodal-user-turn hidden_projection branch is real, deferred work (M9c)

svg.text: Talker prefill embeddings (user rows + fixed 9-row assistant template)

g.text: 20 layers · hidden 1024 · GQA 16 query / 2 KV heads · use_qk_norm
MoE: 128 experts, top-6 routed + ALWAYS-ACTIVE shared expert — width 768, sigmoid-gated
(the shared expert is the one real architectural difference vs the Thinker’s MoE)
vocab 3072 (codec ids) · 3.16 B resident / 0.29 B active per token (M16) · emits codebook-0 tokens at 12.5 Hz
validated: layer cosine 1.000000 (M7a) · speak e2e: real 12.38 s waveform, RMS 0.041 (M9c)

svg.text: codebook-0 tokens @ 12.5 Hz + per-frame Talker hidden state

g.text: tts::mtp::MtpModel — reused byte-identical from Qwen3-TTS · loaded via omni::codec_bridge::load_mtp
5 layers · hidden 1024 · GQA 16 / 8 heads · head_dim 128 · vocab 2048 · dense (no MoE)
predicts residual codebooks 1..15 from codebook-0, per frame → 16 codebooks total
codec::Codec::decode_omni — loaded via omni::codec_bridge::load_codec · RVQ 16 quantizers (1 semantic @ 4096 + 15 acoustic @ 2048)
total upsample 1920 × : 12.5 Hz code rate → 24 000 Hz waveform
chunked_decode(chunk_size 300, left_context_size 25) streaming — implemented in the standalone codec crate, NOT used by Omni: the whole waveform is decoded in one shot
24 kHz mono waveform — speak action only
D-Bus (Run / Subscribe, typed audio · image · video blobs) · OpenAI-compatible HTTP (/v1/chat/completions) · Anthropic-compatible HTTP (/v1/messages)
generate → text out; optional audio / image / video INPUT (generate_spec :68, OmniInner::generate :204 / generate_multimodal :223)
speak → text in; text + 24 kHz speech OUT (speak_spec :94, OmniInner::speak :247)
gaps: the HTTP surfaces drop image_url / input_audio content parts server-side today (only D-Bus carries multimodal blobs) · there is NO converse action (audio / image in + speech out in one call)
DOCUMENTED GAPS (drawn dashed above) — per status.md “Not started” + honesty notes; none of these are implemented
• video FILE decoding — encode_video_frames takes pre-decoded frames only
• converse action (audio / image in + speech out in one turn) — does not exist
• streaming chunked Code2Wav decode inside Omni — one-shot decode only
• OpenAI / Anthropic multimodal content parts — dropped server-side
• DeepStack taps in served encode_image + NPU export — skipped (M15)
• NPU: ONNX export + CPU-side OpenVINO parity only — no on-device run
• precision: the engine runs fp32 throughout vs HF’s bf16 reference — NOT bit-identical (M9b: exact 12-token greedy prefix, then a near-tied logit diverged)

svg.text: brain (applications/edgeai/brain) — Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct, from-scratch Rust + WGSL implementation. Sources: docs/models/omni/status.md (build ledger M0–M21, 2026-08-07 → 2026-08-09), docs/models/omni/readme.md,

crates/{omni, qwen-asr, qwenvl, tts, codec, model}. All numbers from the released config.json / measured runs as recorded in status.md “Facts”. Solid = parity-validated vs real weights · dashed = documented gap. Drawn 2026-08-09.
